newsitem.title: FINLAND: TT Tieto sees positive earnings trend.
newsitem.headline: TT Tieto sees positive earnings trend.

text.p: Finnish information technology group TT Tieto Oy said on Friday it expected group earnings to continue to develop favourably.
"Despite the toughening competition and cost pressures, the group has all the prerequisites for a continuous, positive result development," TT Tieto said in a statement with its 1996 results.
"The demand for information technology services has been further consolidated in all the main market areas of the group following the recession at the beginning of the decade," it said.
"Strong demand is expected to continue through the turn of the century," TT Tieto added.
The group's 1996 profit before extraordinary items rose to 194 million markka -- 9.5 percent of net sales -- from 96 million markka in 1995.
TT Tieto said its long-term pre-tax profit target is 10 percent of net sales.
